author: Jessica Li
comment: The most beautiful sought out movie to watch. Watch it about 4 times a year because it’s truly a cute and romantic love story.

author: Anna Tsou
comment: This movie has little cohesion. Most of the scenes feel standalone, there are no transitions or sensible plot development to connect them and give the sense of passing of time.

author: Jane Doe
comment: They could have done better. The movie is simple and the usual cliché where the popular dude falls in love with the 'outcast' type girl. The actors were average.

author: ashlee
comment: as a teenager watching this movie IM IN LOVE. 10/10 movie. I love when kiss me by sixpence none the richer started playing, this movie is chefs kiss my favorite now.

author: John Monter
comment: Wow. One of the worst movies I ever saw. A movie for teens. I couldn't stand it and had to switch it off after 40 minutes. It was too childish, too predictable and bad.

author: Jess Talamantes
comment: It was pretty bad back in when it first came out and now it's just horrible, the acting is horrible and flat there's no dimension to the characters. I couldn't stop laughing at how horrible it was. These movies need to stay in the 90s and never come back!
